label: XML Schema Part 2 datatypes: -1 is not a positiveInteger, so the order is not valid

steps.value:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
  <xs:element name="order">
    <xs:complexType>
      <xs:sequence>
        <xs:element name="qty" type="xs:positiveInteger"/>
        <xs:element name="sku" type="xs:string"/>
      </xs:sequence>
      <xs:attribute name="id" type="xs:int" use="required"/>
    </xs:complexType>
  </xs:element>
</xs:schema>

expect: '-1' is not a valid value of the atomic type 'xs:positiveInteger'
